operations.title: The total-parity defect does not select the positive physical cycle
operations.body: For V_van=Q^8/<r> with r_epsilon=epsilon2 epsilon3 epsilon4, the literal positive-node coordinate functional has f_+(r)=1 and therefore does not descend. The deck-invariant orbit sum descends but is not supplied by the frozen positive contour.

operations.title: Positive-node functional descent audit
operations.body: Exact checker evaluates the positive coordinate and orbit-sum functionals on the total-parity relation, obtaining 1 and 0 respectively.

operations.title: Benincasa reports that the node defect does not activate the physical cycle
operations.body: Entry 1173: the canonical rank-seven node lattice does not repair physical activation. The literal positive-node functional evaluates to 1 on the total-parity relation, so it does not descend to Q^8/<r>. The deck-orbit sum does descend, but averaging over all eight nodes is not authorized by the frozen positive contour. This is a coefficient/physical-comparison gap, not a carrier failure.

authority_basis.summary: Record the completed descent audit for the literal positive-node functional.
